notes: Intent catalog for the banking intent router. 'category' drives routing policy: view = read-only, action = moves money (always needs confirmation), info = how-to / help, none = fallback.

intents.description: Customer wants to know how much money is currently in an account.
Customer wants a short list of their most recent transactions (roughly the last 5-10).
includes: what came in or went out lately
excludes: a statement for a date range (full_statement)

intents.description: Customer wants a complete statement for a period, usually as a document (PDF) to their own registered email or for download.
includes: bank statement for a loan/visa application
excludes: sending a statement to a third party (unsupported in v1)

intents.description: Customer is looking for one specific past transaction, identified by date, amount, person or reference.
includes: check status of a transfer I made

intents.description: Customer wants the receipt or proof of payment for a completed transaction.
excludes: searching for whether a transaction happened (find_transaction)

intents.description: Customer wants to move money between their own accounts or to another customer of the same bank.
includes: move money from savings to current
send to another account in this bank
excludes: sending to another bank or mobile wallet (external_transfer)

intents.description: Customer wants to send money out of the bank: to another bank (PesaLink/EFT/RTGS) or to a mobile wallet number.
Customer wants to pay a merchant or biller via Lipa na M-Pesa: Buy Goods (till number) or Paybill (business number + account).
excludes: sending to a person's phone number (external_transfer)

intents.description: Customer is asking HOW transfers/payments work, their limits, charges or timings, without asking to perform one now.
includes: how do I send to another bank
excludes: actually performing a transfer (internal_transfer / external_transfer / lipa_na_mpesa)

intents.description: Anything outside the catalog: loans, cards, account opening, complaints, fraud reports, chit-chat. Never forced into the nearest intent.
